subject.title: fix(auth-health): prefer usable OAuth over expired inventory in provider status

question: Should provider-level auth status ever allow a healthy OAuth profile to mask a missing configured OAuth profile?
rationale: The existing gateway comments and tests treat missing OAuth as an operator-visible setup/auth failure, but this PR changes that contract unless maintainers explicitly decide healthy credentials should hide missing inventory.

options.title: Preserve Missing Visibility
options.body: Keep missing OAuth precedence ahead of the healthy override and limit this PR to stale expired inventory masking.

options.title: Allow Healthy To Mask Missing
options.body: Accept the new behavior as a product decision and add focused tests/docs for why missing inventory is no longer provider-red when another OAuth credential is usable.

recommendation.title: Preserve Missing Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep missing OAuth precedence ahead of the healthy override and limit this PR to stale expired inventory masking.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth-provider/status commits in this boundary make steipete the best available owner for the status-contract choice.
